data_object.title: Data Object
data_object.description: Medallia data source to extract. v1 supports Feedback.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Field IDs to extract, one output column each.

options.tooltip: Medallia field IDs (e.g. `e_nps`, `a_survey_channel`). Use Load Fields to pick from the instance metadata, or type IDs manually. Each field's values become one output column.

survey_id_field_id.title: Survey ID Field
survey_id_field_id.description: Field ID that identifies the survey; used as the table primary key.

options.tooltip: The field ID holding the unique survey identifier. Written to the `surveyId` output column and set as the primary key for incremental upserts.

finish_date_field_id.title: Finish Date Field
finish_date_field_id.description: Field ID used as the incremental watermark (ordering + cursor).

options.tooltip: The finish-date field driving both ordering and the incremental cursor. Default `k_initialfinishdate_epoch_int` is the Unix-epoch-seconds K-field; for a DATETIME field use its field ID and set Finish Date Field Type to Datetime. Entered manually because computed K-fields may not appear in the field metadata list.

finish_date_field_type.title: Finish Date Field Type
finish_date_field_type.description: Value format of the finish date field.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: Incremental keeps a watermark and fetches only new records.

initial_start_epoch.title: Initial Start (Epoch Seconds)
initial_start_epoch.description: First-run lower bound (finish-date epoch seconds) when no state exists.

options.tooltip: Unix epoch seconds. On the first run (empty state) only records with a finish date after this value are fetched. Leave empty to load full history.

initial_start_value.title: Initial Start (Datetime)
initial_start_value.description: First-run lower bound as an ISO date/datetime string when no state exists.

options.tooltip: ISO 8601 date (e.g. `2026-01-01`). On the first run (empty state) only records with a finish date after this value are fetched. Leave empty to load full history.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Records per request; capped at the Medallia maximum of 1000.

options.tooltip: The `first` argument sent on every query. Defaults to 100; values above the Medallia maximum of 1000 are clamped.

filters.title: Business Filters (Advanced)
filters.description: Optional Medallia filter tree merged into the query.

options.tooltip: Advanced: a raw Medallia filter object (`and`/`or`/`not`, `in`, `gt`/`gte`/`lt`/`lte`, `isNull`) with `fieldIds`. Merged with the incremental watermark filter. Leave empty for no extra filtering.
